template_rule: Non-executable draft. The implementation-freeze commit is made first. Only after bsub -H and raw bjobs capture may a one-time FINAL_HELD_JOB_TEMPLATE be materialized. The materializer must receive exactly the three ordered BLIND circuit roots (s9234, s38584, wb_dma); each final circuit is exactly {name,root}, with a nonempty absolute unique root. The final template never contains a receipt or its own digest, preventing a digest cycle.
